description: Phase 6bb gate — ASC/DESC modifier in CREATE INDEX column list. Parse-only extension; no execution-time effect in v1. max_invariant=43 unchanged.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX i ON t (a ASC);
SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY a;
CREATE INDEX i ON t (a DESC);
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX i ON t (a ASC, b DESC);

cases.name: create-index-default-direction
cases.description: Column without ASC/DESC defaults to ASC; mixing default and explicit is fine.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, c INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX i ON t (a, b DESC, c);

cases.name: create-index-desc-duplicate-errors
cases.description: ASC DESC adjacent on same column — parse error on the second direction token.

program.sql: CREATE INDEX i ON t (a ASC DESC);
CREATE INDEX i ON t (a DESC);
